subject: Next steps on procurement path & SOC 2 gating - Adept Health
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Kulkarni <samir.kulkarni@adepthealth.com>, Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@adepthealth.com>
Cc: procurement@adepthealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Quick recap + procurement questions (SOC 2 / PO vs card)

Hi Samir / Jill —

Thanks again for the time this morning — great to learn more about Adept Health's roadmap for clinical triage and why latency/cost predictability matter for you. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned on procurement gating: 

What we covered
- Use case: triage assistant for nurse call triage, ~500 active daily users to start, spiky traffic at 8am/6pm.
- Success metrics: <200ms p95 for short prompts, predictable per-token cost.
- Security: you need SOC 2 Type II report + executed DPA before procurement can sign.

Procurement path questions (need your confirmation)
1) Payment method: do you require a Purchase Order (PO) and invoice billing, or would the team consider corporate card/marketplace initial pilot?
2) Timeline: when will procurement need SOC 2 evidence and the DPA signed (approx date)?
3) Security questionnaire: do you have a vendor security questionnaire we should complete, or is SOC 2 + DPA sufficient for your procurement team?

What we can provide quickly
- SOC 2 executive summary (attached) and the SOC 2 letter under NDA if needed.
- A DPA draft we can pre-fill for your legal team (attached).
- Option: we can start a short pilot via marketplace (faster onboarding) while procurement completes PO process — happy to discuss tradeoffs.

Proposed next steps
- Samir: confirm PO vs card and rough procurement timeline this week.
- Jill: if you have a questionnaire, please share it and we’ll aim to return answers within 3 business days.
- I’ll loop in commercial for pricing path once payment method confirmed.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: (415) 555-0189

Attachments:
- SOC2-summary.pdf (summary of controls and report availability)
- DPA-draft_Adept.docx (pre-filled template for discussion)

From: Samir Kulkarni <samir.kulkarni@adepthealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@adepthealth.com>, procurement@adepthealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 13:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement questions (SOC 2 / PO vs card)

Evelyn —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Short answers from procurement side:
- Payment method: Adept requires PO & net-30 invoicing for any production contracts. We could consider a corporate card for a short pilot but procurement typically prefers marketplace agreements that produce a PO for governance.
- Timeline: Procurement will need SOC 2 artifacts and an executed DPA before they issue a PO. Realistically, that's a 3-4 week window assuming no outstanding questionnaire items.
- Questionnaire: We do have a standard security questionnaire (I’m attaching the PDF). If you can return that, it will speed procurement review.

Two asks for you:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide SOC 2 Type II full report under NDA (procurement will require this to move to PO)?
2) Please indicate whether you have a marketplace offering (we prefer to purchase via Azure Marketplace if available) — if so, what are the tradeoffs for observability / support vs direct contract?

If it helps, I can schedule a quick sync between procurement and our security lead this week.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Program Manager, IT Procurement
Adept Health

Attachment: Adept_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: Quick recap + procurement questions (SOC 2 / PO vs card) — Adept Health (need guidance)

Forwarding Samir's reply — procurement will require PO and SOC 2 + DPA before issuing. Key asks below and my suggested approach: 

Quoted message from Samir Kulkarni:
> Evelyn —
> 
> Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. Short answers from procurement side:
> - Payment method: Adept requires PO & net-30 invoicing for any production contracts. We could consider a corporate card for a short pilot but procurement typically prefers marketplace agreements that produce a PO for governance.
> - Timeline: Procurement will need SOC 2 artifacts and an executed DPA before they issue a PO. Realistically, that's a 3-4 week window assuming no outstanding questionnaire items.
> - Questionnaire: We do have a standard security questionnaire (I’m attaching the PDF). If you can return that, it will speed procurement review.

My notes / asks for commercial: 
- Ben: given they need a PO + net-30, recommend we propose 30-day pilot (marketplace) to get started while procurement completes PO; offer an account credit for first month if they commit to production PO within 45 days. Thoughts on discount / credit amount?
- Laura: procurement will require SOC 2 full report under NDA — do we have a process to get that executed quickly? Also confirm whether our DPA draft is the latest.

Attachments included to external: SOC2-summary.pdf, DPA-draft_Adept.docx, commercial-path-options.pdf

Happy to set up an internal 15-min quick to finalize the pilot offer and legal ask.

Thanks,
Evelyn

---
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap + procurement questions (SOC 2 / PO vs card) — Adept Health (need guidance)

Eve / Laura —

Thanks for the context. I agree with the approach to keep them moving via a pilot while procurement completes PO. My recommended inbound motion: 

1) Pilot via marketplace (if Adept is open) — fast onboarding, produces PO for accounting, and allows the clinical team to validate latency/cost without full contract. If marketplace not viable, accept corporate card for a 30-day eval with a signed SOW.

2) Commercial incentive: offer a one-time credit equivalent to 25% of first-month billed usage (applied when PO converts to production contract) OR a fixed $10k credit if they commit to a 12-month reserved capacity within 45 days. Use the smaller of the two calculations per their scale.

3) Security / legal: Laura — please confirm we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. If yes, I’ll authorize sharing after we get a simple mutual NDA executed (I can route to legal). Also confirm that the DPA-draft_Adept.docx is the current template; if not, I’ll ask legal to send the right one. 

Operational asks: Evelyn — get clarity from Samir on marketplace preference (Azure vs none) and a target date for completed questionnaire. If they expect >4 weeks, escalate to CS for a more guarded pilot mode.

I’ll prepare a short pilot offer email template and share it in Drive (commercial-path-options.pdf attached earlier).

Ben
Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment: commercial-path-options.pdf
